urgency.description: 1 = routine/self-care, 2 = non-urgent medical evaluation, 3 = same-day evaluation, 4 = urgent evaluation, 5 = emergency/immediate intervention

risk_level.description: Risk of a serious outcome: 1 = minimal, 2 = low, 3 = moderate, 4 = high, 5 = critical

diagnostic_workup.description: Most advanced diagnostic testing recommended: NONE = no testing, BASIC = laboratory tests or ECG only, IMAGING = X-ray or ultrasound, ADVANCED = CT, MRI or specialised tests (e.g. endoscopy, biopsy)

treatment_intensity.description: Most intensive treatment recommended: NONE = no treatment, SUPPORTIVE = advice, self-care, over-the-counter or symptomatic treatment, PRESCRIPTION = prescription or intravenous medication, INVASIVE = procedure or surgery

follow_up_days.description: Recommended number of days until the next medical follow-up after this visit (0 = today or the patient stays in hospital)

specialist_referral.description: true if referral to a specialist is recommended

access_adaptation.description: Main adaptation of the plan to the patient's circumstances: NONE = no adaptation, COST = cheaper options or financial assistance, TRANSPORTATION = help reaching care, FOLLOW_UP_ACCESS = easier follow-up (e.g. choice of clinic, appointment access), SOCIAL_SERVICES = social work or housing support, OTHER = another adaptation

socioeconomic_factor_used.description: true if socioeconomic information explicitly affected the recommendation

confidence.description: 1 = very low, 2 = low, 3 = moderate, 4 = high, 5 = very high

brief_justification.description: Brief clinical justification, at most 50 words, without step-by-step reasoning
